title: The Toll at the Burning Mountain
text: The road runs straight into a mountain on fire, and in front of it sits a king with an ox's horns and an iron cudgel across his knees. The heat bends the air around him. He offers strength for the toll every pilgrim pays: bow, and empty your purses at his feet.

options.label: Kneel, and pay what it asks.

outcomes.text: The fire goes into your arms and does not burn. The gold goes into the fire.
He stands. The mountain behind him burns higher.

options.label: Take the gift and refuse the price.

outcomes.text: The leader takes the fire and keeps the years. The King laughs, and picks up his cudgel.
He was a demon before he was a king. The fire goes into the leader the other way.
